newsitem.title: BELARUS: FOUR CHERNOBYL CHILDREN DIE IN BELGIAN BUS CRASH.
newsitem.headline: FOUR CHERNOBYL CHILDREN DIE IN BELGIAN BUS CRASH.

text.p: A bus carrying children from regions of Belarus affected by the Chernobyl nuclear accident overturned at speed, killing four of the children and injuring more than 60, police said on Wednesday.
An interior ministry spokesman said the crash happened late on Tuesday during rain in southern Belarus.
Seventy children aged between seven and 14 had been on the bus travelling to hospitals in Belgium. Three were seriously hurt and 60 had less serious injuries, the spokesman said.
The fate of the Belgian driver was not immediately clear. Children in several other buses heading for Belgium were not hurt.
The accident at Chernobyl in Ukraine in April 1986 sent a radiation cloud over Belarus and other countries.
Many countries have been taking children from the affected regions to hospitals and rehabilitation centres abroad for medical treatment.
